name: TRIM32-related limb-girdle muscular dystrophy R8

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for TRIM32-related LGMD R8

criteria.description: Progressive proximal muscle weakness predominantly affecting pelvic and shoulder girdle muscles
Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes with reduced or absent TRIM32 protein expression
Identification of pathogenic biallelic variants in the TRIM32 gene
Elevated serum creatine kinase levels (mild to moderate elevation)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive proximal muscle weakness with either muscle biopsy findings or genetic confirmation of TRIM32 mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis due to phenotypic overlap with other LGMD subtypes.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Increased variability in muscle fiber diameter
Proximal muscle weakness in lower limbs

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated liver enzymes
imaging: Muscle MRI showing fatty replacement and atrophy of proximal limb muscles
other: Muscle biopsy demonstrating dystrophic changes and reduced TRIM32 protein expression by immunohistochemistry

distinguishingFeatures: Absent dysferlin protein on muscle biopsy

redFlags: Rapidly progressive muscle weakness over weeks
Cardiac arrhythmias or heart failure symptoms
references: Nallamilli BRR, et al. Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Overview. GeneReviews® [Internet]. 2020.
